requirements.evidence: Code cannot work as written: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:12 `use Livewire\WithValidation;` (no such trait) and :21 `submit(): void` returns a redirect (fatal TypeError); app/Models/Entity.php:8 imports `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\HasFactory` (real namespace is `...\Factories\HasFactory`) and :14 uses `#[SoftDeletes]` as an attribute instead of the trait; app/Http/Kernel.php:10-15 replaces the `web` middleware group with an empty array. No slug-collision retry in CreateEntity::submit (uniqueSlug called once, before the transaction). Switcher route has `current_entity` (routes/web.php:36), so users with >1 memberships and no session get redirected to the switcher in a loop. Navbar link to the switcher is missing; no tests. owner_seq uses `generatedAs` (identity), not `storedAs` (database/migrations/..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:20).

conventions.evidence: No Action class for entity creation (writes inline in CreateEntity.php:27-38 and a route closure); `$this->validate([...])` inline instead of `#[Validate]`; no `$this->authorize('create', Entity::class)`; migrations hand-written as old-style named classes, not generated anonymous migrations; legacy Kernel.php/AuthServiceProvider.php added; docs/database-schema.md overwritten to three bullets; lang files wiped; no CHANGELOG entry; inline styles in switcher.blade.php:5-7.

security.evidence: `role` is cast to `UserRole` (EntityMembership.php:17) but policies compare against string values: EntityMembershipPolicy.php:28 `$membership->role === UserRole::Owner->value` is always false, so the owner's membership can be deleted by an admin (and owner self-delete allowed); `in_array($current->role, [ 'owner','admin' ])` is always false so owners/admins are denied everything (EntityPolicy.php:22,28,34). CurrentEntity middleware (Middleware/CurrentEntity.php:35) only compares route entity to the session id and never checks membership of the session entity, and uses strict `!==` against a session value; no Livewire persistent middleware registered for Dashboard.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no test files at all; no unauthorized-call or tamper tests for CreateEntity, no policy, middleware or route tests.

simplicity.evidence: Duplicated dispatch logic in routes/web.php:19-29 and CurrentEntity.php:17-32; redundant ROLE_* string constants in EntityMembership.php:19-21 alongside the UserRole enum; unnecessary Kernel.php/AuthServiceProvider.php boilerplate.

readability.evidence: Placeholder comments `// existing...` and `// other groups` in Kernel.php:12-15; `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;` declared mid-file in routes/web.php:37; unused `use Illuminate\Gate\Gate;` (AuthServiceProvider.php:10); mis-indented Blade in switcher.blade.php.

scope.evidence: Deletes all existing auth screen strings in lang/en/ui.php and lang/pt_BR/ui.php (login/register/verify keys) and deletes the whole ER model in docs/database-schema.md; replaces the HTTP kernel's web middleware group. These deletions are unrelated to the task and destructive.

issues.explanation: `Livewire\WithValidation` does not exist and `submit(): void` returns a redirect, so the onboarding component fatals.
Wrong HasFactory namespace and `#[SoftDeletes]` used as an attribute instead of the trait; the model fails to load / has no soft deletes.
A placeholder HTTP Kernel with an empty `web` middleware group would strip sessions/CSRF from every web route if loaded.
All existing UI strings for login, register, password reset and verification are deleted, breaking existing screens.
Comparing the enum-cast role to the string 'owner' is always false, so the owner's membership can be deleted, violating the core invariant.
`in_array`/`===` against string values with an enum-cast role always fail, so owners/admins are denied update, delete, settings and assignRole.
Middleware never verifies the user is a member of the session entity and never builds a tenant context; it only compares the route entity with the session id.
The switcher route uses `current_entity`, which redirects users with several memberships and no session back to the switcher in an infinite loop.
No retry when the slug collides at insert time; a unique-constraint violation just bubbles up.
`generatedAs` defines an identity column, not a stored generated column; `storedAs` was required for the one-owner constraint.
No tests are included for any new behaviour, contrary to the TDD convention.
The whole schema document is deleted and replaced by three bullets instead of being updated.
The navbar link to `entity.switcher` for users with more than one membership is not implemented.
Domain write is done inline rather than in an `app/Actions` class, with no `#[Validate]` and no policy authorization.
Hand-written named-class migrations instead of generated anonymous migrations.
Dashboard does not authorize `view` and the `current_entity` middleware is not registered as Livewire persistent middleware.
Slug is derived from fake company name without uniqueness, so factories can collide.
`use` statement placed in the middle of the routes file.

review.summary: The change sketches entities, memberships, policies, middleware, onboarding, switcher and dashboard, but much of it cannot run (non-existent Livewire trait, wrong HasFactory namespace, void method returning a redirect, a placeholder Kernel that empties the web middleware group). The enum cast breaks every policy role check, including the rule that protects the owner's membership. It also deletes existing lang strings and the schema docs, ships no tests, and skips Actions, #[Validate] and the slug-collision retry. Reject.
